entities.name: MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by the network to the UE to request modification of an active EPS bearer context or re-negotiation of header compression configuration.

entities.name: Protocol discriminator
entities.description: Identifies the protocol type for the message.

entities.name: EPS bearer identity
entities.description: Identifies the EPS bearer context to be modified.

entities.name: Procedure transaction identity
entities.description: Identifies the procedure transaction associated with the message.

entities.name: Modify EPS bearer context request message identity
entities.description: Identifies the message type as MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST.

entities.name: New EPS QoS
entities.description: Specifies the new EPS Quality of Service parameters for the bearer.

entities.name: TFT
entities.description: Traffic Flow Template defining packet filters for the bearer.

entities.name: Header compression configuration
entities.description: Specifies header compression parameters for control plane CIoT EPS optimization.

entities.name: UE support of Control plane CIoT EPS optimization
entities.description: Condition where the UE has indicated support for Control plane CIoT EPS optimization and Header compression for control plane CIoT EPS optimization.

relations.description: The message includes the Protocol discriminator IE.
The message includes the EPS bearer identity IE.
The message includes the Procedure transaction identity IE.
The message includes the Message type IE.
The message optionally includes the New EPS QoS IE.
The message optionally includes the TFT IE.
The message optionally includes the Header compression configuration IE.
The message may be used for header compression re-negotiation if the UE supports Control plane CIoT EPS optimization.
